# Product pricing 

monday.com now offers four standalone products, each built on monday Work OS and tailored to a specific workflow need.

 Click to view the products: 

- monday AI work platform: A flexible workflow system that helps teams track tasks, manage projects, and collaborate at scale. 
- monday CRM: A centralized platform to manage leads, contacts, sales pipelines, and customer relationships. 
- monday dev: Built for software development teams managing sprints, roadmaps, and product feedback. 
- monday service: A unified platform that connects ticketing, operations, and cross-functional teams in one place.

Each of our products is individually priced based on the features and functionality available. You can choose to purchase any of the monday products individually or bundle multiple products together, depending on your organization’s needs.

When bundling, each product can be on a different plan and have a different number of seats, but all products must share the same billing cycle, whether monthly or yearly.

# How much does monday.com cost? Pricing plans explained

Raphael Landau

Updated on Mar 2, 2025

Choosing the right project management platform is all about finding the perfect fit for your needs — and pricing naturally plays a key role in that decision.. Whether you’re a solo entrepreneur, growing team, or large enterprise, your project management needs and available budget will likely vary. That’s why at monday.com, we created a simple pricing structure with flexible pricing plans designed for everyone. 

Since transparency is at the core of everything we do, we want you to know exactly what you’re getting with each plan. In this guide, we’ll walk you through our different pricing plans, what’s included in each, and how to choose the right one that best fits your goals.

## How does monday.com pricing work? 

There’s no simple answer here, as project management software isn’t a one-size-fits-all solution, and our pricing structure reflects just that.

> We offer multiple industry-specific products — monday.com, monday CRM, and monday dev, — each built upon the internal no-code building blocks of the monday.com Work OS, so anyone can easily create or customize software that suits their needs.

Each of these products has a unique pricing plan ranging from completely free to requiring a customizable quote.

We know people and companies leverage our software for a variety of use cases — whether it’s organizing a personal project to running an enterprise-level CRM solution. We sought to create a pricing structure that is anything but limiting so all types of teams and users can access our software.

Our pricing structure factors in many elements, including:

- Which product you choose (monday.com, monday CRM, monday dev, or monday service)
- Which plan you pick — depending on what features and capabilities you may need
- Number of seats you need
- Whether you’re paying yearly or monthly (paying yearly includes an 18% discount)

Here’s a general overview of our monthly pricing plans, but read on to learn about each product and its pricing breakdown.

| | monday work management | monday CRM | monday dev | monday service |

| Free | Basic features, 2 seats | | | |

| Standard | $12/ seat | $17/ seat | $12/ seat | $26/ seat |
| Pro | $19/ seat | $28/ seat | $20/ seat | $38/ seat |
| Enterprise | Upon request | Upon request | Upon request | Upon request |

## monday.com pricing plans

monday.com is the intuitive workflow management product designed for teams to plan, manage, and visualize their work to achieve efficient processes and reach shared goals at scale. It’s suitable for multiple industries, including marketing, operations, HR, and various use cases such as task management, project management, portfolio management, and more.

Here’s a table outlining the basic differences between the plans, and below we’ll dive further into the different pricing tiers.

| Pro | $19 | Large teams | 100GB | 25,000 | From up to 20 boards | 500 AI credits |
| Enterprise | Upon request | Enterprise businesses | Custom | 250,000 | From up to 50 boards | 500 AI credits |

So there you have it — all the information to make an informed choice for which monday.com plan is best for you. For more information, you can always take a look at the monday.com pricing page. But if you want to get things moving give monday.com a start with a 14-day free trial offered on each of our plans. From there, you can get a better feel of our platform, and then decide which plan you want to move forward with.
